{
  "id": "openclaw-authbus",
  "name": "OpenClaw AuthBus",
  "description": "Synchronizes auth credentials through an OpenBao control plane",
  "activation": {
    "onStartup": true
  },
  "configSchema": {
    "type": "object",
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "required": [
      "address",
      "caFile",
      "roleIdFile",
      "secretIdFile",
      "hostId"
    ],
    "properties": {
      "address": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^https://" },
      "caFile": { "type": "string" },
      "roleIdFile": { "type": "string" },
      "secretIdFile": { "type": "string" },
      "hostId": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$" },
      "pollIntervalMs": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 5000, "maximum": 300000 },
      "refreshMarginMs": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 300000, "maximum": 86400000 },
      "maxRefreshesPerCycle": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 10 },
      "leader": { "type": "boolean" },
      "publishNew": { "type": "boolean" },
      "manageOrder": { "type": "boolean" },
      "schedulerMode": { "type": "string", "enum": ["shadow", "enforce"] },
      "schedulerReportIntervalMs": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 15000, "maximum": 300000 },
      "enforceRefreshLeases": { "type": "boolean" },
      "releaseGeneration": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 2147483647 },
      "orderExcludeAgentIds": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,127}$"
        },
        "uniqueItems": true,
        "maxItems": 128
      }
    }
  }
}
